text: {"sql": "WITH f10_stops AS (SELECT DISTINCT ts AS stop_ts FROM sf_ops.andon_events WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND stopped_line = true) SELECT m.machine_id, COUNT(*) AS telemetry_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN t.failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.overstrain_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overstrain_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heat_dissipation_count, ROUND(AVG(t.tool_wear_min), 1) AS avg_tool_wear_min, ROUND(AVG(t.rpm), 1) AS avg_rpm, ROUND(AVG(t.torque_nm), 1) AS avg_torque_nm FROM sf_plant.machines AS m JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry AS t ON t.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE m.station_id = 'F10' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f10_stops s WHERE t.ts BETWEEN s.stop_ts - INTERVAL '2' HOURS AND s.stop_ts + INTERVAL '2' HOURS) GROUP BY m.machine_id ORDER BY failure_count DESC, m.machine_id LIMIT 20", "columns": ["machine_id", "telemetry_hours", "failure_count", "overstrain_count", "heat_dissipation_count", "avg_tool_wear_min", "avg_rpm", "avg_torque_nm"], "purpose": "Aggregated machine-level fault signals for F10 machines around stop/andon start hours"}

data.sql: WITH f10_stops AS (SELECT DISTINCT ts AS stop_ts FROM sf_ops.andon_events WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND stopped_line = true) SELECT m.machine_id, COUNT(*) AS telemetry_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN t.failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.overstrain_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overstrain_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heat_dissipation_count, ROUND(AVG(t.tool_wear_min), 1) AS avg_tool_wear_min, ROUND(AVG(t.rpm), 1) AS avg_rpm, ROUND(AVG(t.torque_nm), 1) AS avg_torque_nm FROM sf_plant.machines AS m JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry AS t ON t.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE m.station_id = 'F10' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f10_stops s WHERE t.ts BETWEEN s.stop_ts - INTERVAL '2' HOURS AND s.stop_ts + INTERVAL '2' HOURS) GROUP BY m.machine_id ORDER BY failure_count DESC, m.machine_id LIMIT 20
data.purpose: Aggregated machine-level fault signals for F10 machines around stop/andon start hours
